## Change / 改动

Describe the change and link the related issue, if any.
说明改动内容，如有关联 issue，请附上链接。

## Validation / 验证

Record the checks you ran and their results. For layout changes, include screenshots of the expanded sidebar and collapsed rail, plus any keyboard or focus checks.
记录运行过的检查及结果。布局改动请附上展开侧栏和折叠图标栏的截图，并说明键盘操作或焦点检查结果。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Note any changes to configuration, locale keys, package contents or DSH compatibility. Write “none” if these are unchanged.
说明配置、翻译键、打包内容或 DSH 兼容性是否变化；没有变化可写“无”。
